title: 黑水河辨鼍龙
subtitle: 多看线索，再相信带路人
origin: 《西游记》第四十三回（低龄温和改编）

moral.zh: 陌生邀请要先核对身份和路线；发现不对时及时求助，比逞强更勇敢。
moral.en: Check identities and routes before following an unfamiliar invitation. Asking for help is wiser than pretending nothing is wrong.

pages.zh: 黑水河没有桥，岸边却停着一只画着龙鳞花纹的小船。
pages.en: There was no bridge over Blackwater River, only a little boat painted with scale patterns.
pages.prompt: Full team stands at a calm dark-blue river beside a small safe ferry with abstract scale patterns and no writing; bright daytime, no text in image.

pages.zh: 船夫说能带大家过河。悟空却发现，他的船牌颜色和岸边告示不一样。
pages.en: The boatman offered a crossing, but Wukong noticed his ferry token did not match the shore marker.
pages.prompt: Wukong compares a blank blue ferry token with a differently colored geometric shore marker; friendly reptile-faced boatman waits, no readable text, no text in image.

pages.zh: 船刚离岸，就转向芦苇深处。悟空让伙伴坐稳，自己留下金线记路。
pages.en: Once afloat, the boat turned into the reeds. Wukong kept everyone seated and left a golden thread to mark the route.
pages.prompt: Team sits safely in a broad ferry through sunny reeds while Wukong trails a harmless glowing thread along posts; calm caution, no text in image.

pages.zh: 船来到水府，鼍龙少年端出点心：“我只是想请取经人来做客。”
pages.en: At a water palace, the young river dragon served snacks. “I only wanted the travelers to visit,” he said.
pages.prompt: A friendly rounded young crocodile-dragon with teal scales and a blue vest offers snacks in a bright underwater hall; team remains together, no fear, no text in image.

pages.zh: 唐僧说：“邀请要说清楚，带错路会让客人担心，也会耽误行程。”
pages.en: Tang Seng replied, “An invitation must be clear. A false route worries guests and delays their journey.”
pages.prompt: Tang Seng speaks kindly to the seated young river dragon across a low table; Wukong and companions listen, open respectful scene, no text in image.

pages.zh: 悟空请西海龙王核对身份。原来鼍龙是龙族晚辈，偷偷借了旧渡船。
pages.en: Wukong asked the Western Dragon King to verify the visitor. The young dragon was a relative who had secretly borrowed an old ferry.
pages.prompt: A dignified friendly sea dragon king arrives with pearl attendants and checks the old ferry token; young dragon looks embarrassed, no punishment, no text in image.

pages.zh: 鼍龙归还渡船，换上真正的船牌，还陪大家沿金线安全回到大河。
pages.en: The young dragon returned the ferry, fitted the proper token, and guided everyone safely back along the golden thread.
pages.prompt: Young river dragon steers the ferry along Wukong's glowing thread with correct matching color markers; team relaxed, bright river, no text in image.

pages.zh: 临别时，他在两岸挂起同色路标。以后每位旅人都能先确认、再上船。
pages.en: Before goodbye, he placed matching markers on both shores so every traveler could check before boarding.
pages.prompt: Young dragon and team install matching simple color-and-shape markers on both riverbanks; community safety ending, no readable words, no text in image.
